tagline: Fast stock issue and GST billing, built for the keyboard
name: Your name

migrate.title: Upload the data saved in this browser?
migrate.body: This browser has {{items}} items, {{parties}} parties and {{vouchers}} bills from before you had an account. Upload them to your account so they are available everywhere.
migrate.keepNote: The copy in this browser is kept until you remove it.
migrate.settingsTitle: Data from before you signed up
migrate.settingsBody: Items, parties and bills saved in this browser can be uploaded once to your account.
migrate.settingsNone: There is no data saved in this browser.
migrate.settingsAgain: Your account already has data. Uploading adds to it, and any item code that already exists will stop the upload.
migrate.failed: Upload stopped: {{reason}}. Nothing was lost; the data in this browser is unchanged.

danger.passwordHint: Enter your account password to confirm.

downloading: Downloading your data to this device…

needsInternet.title: Internet needed once
needsInternet.body: The first time you sign in on this device, your items, parties and recent bills are downloaded. Connect to the internet and try again.
needsInternet.retryHint: The download did not finish. Please try again.

logoutWarn.title: Bills have not synced
logoutWarn.body: {{count}} bill(s) made on this device have not reached the server. If you sign out now they will be lost. Stay signed in until you are online, or sign out anyway.

storageBlocked.title: This browser cannot store your data
storageBlocked.body: RapidBill keeps a copy of your data on this device so it works without internet. Your browser is blocking that, which usually means private or incognito mode. Open the site in a normal window and try again.

sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
sessionExpiredUnsent: Your {{count}} unsent item(s) are safe on this device and will be sent after you sign in.
points: Works offline — bill even when the internet is down
GST-ready invoices and stock, in one place
Built for the keyboard: fast at the counter
welcomeSub: Sign in to continue to your shop

onboarding.title: Where is your business?
onboarding.sub: This goes on the invoices of {{name}}. You can change it any time in Settings.
onboarding.stateNeeded: Choose your state. It decides CGST+SGST or IGST on your bills.
onboarding.noGst: My business does not have GST
onboarding.gstinHint: 15 characters. We will pick your state from it.

createSub: Free for 15 days. No card needed.

tabSwitched.title: You opened {{name}} in another tab
tabSwitched.body: This tab still shows a different business. To avoid mixing up bills and stock, continue with {{name}} here too.

deleteAccount.body: Delete your RapidBill account for good. These businesses and everything in them (items, parties, bills, settings) are deleted, and anyone who works in them loses access:
deleteAccount.kept: Your plan payments and tax invoices are kept, because they are tax records. They hold no business data.
deleteAccount.gst: Bills you issued are your own GST records. Download what you need to keep (Settings, Device data) before deleting. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.unsent: {{count}} bill(s) made on this device have not reached the server and will be lost. Stay online until they are sent first.
deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.confirmBody_one: Your account and your {{count}} business will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmBody_other: Your account and your {{count}} businesses will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sub: Enter the email you signed up with. We will send you a 6-digit code.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} has an account, a code is on its way. It works for 10 minutes.
forgot.codeShape: Enter the 6 digits from the email
forgot.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

referral.label: Referral code (optional)
referral.hint: If a fellow shopkeeper told you about RapidBill, enter their code.
referral.notFound: We could not find this code. Check it, or leave it empty.
